sentences.text: 1 th 18/Dated: 10 September, 2024 1.
Heard the parties.

2. The description of land is as follows:-
"The land measuring an area of 4.43 acres situated in Mouza-Simaria."
3.
It appears that the land has been subjected to Land Acquisition and for which a proceeding has been initiated in the year 2015.
The Award has been prepared on 08.02.2016.
4. The monetization of the land has been done on the basis of agricultural produce which is an alien concept to the present Land Acquisition Act.
5. This writ petition has been filed challenging that the decision has been taken on the basis of notification contained in Memo No.567 dated 27.04.2016.
6. Admittedly, the Award has been prepared prior to the issuance of this notification.
So the Award has not been prepared as per this notification.
Further, this notification cannot control the Act and it is clarified that the above notification cannot control the mandate of the Act so far as the monetization part is concerned.
7. Further, challenge has been thrown to the Annexure-4 of the present writ petition i.e. notification contained in Memo No.292 dated 26.03.2011, this has been issued under the old Act.
After coming of the new Act, this notification itself has lost its force.
This cannot be utilized as a methodology for monetization of the claim of the awardee.
The claim of the awardee can be monetized only on the basis of the mandate of the Act itself.
8. It is settled law that legislative Act cannot be supplanted by the rule, regulation or any executive instruction.
At best, it can supplemented.
But, in no case, the rules, regulation or notification can be in conflict with the Act.
If there is a conflict then the Act will prevail.
9. With the above clarification, the present writ petition stands disposed of giving liberty to the petitioner to work out his remedy in accordance with law.

10. If the petitioner approach the concerned authority for reference of the case under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the authority is directed to refer the same.
